name: Mayotte
facts: Overseas department and region of France

flag.description: A local flag with no official status: a white field with Mayotte's coat of arms in the centre, a shield held by two seahorses above the motto "Ra Hachiri", under the word MAYOTTE in red. The official flag is the French tricolour.
flag.symbolism: The crescent reflects the island's Muslim faith and the two yellow flowers are ylang-ylang, grown on Mayotte for perfume; the seahorses are said to echo the shape of the island.

hook: Mayotte is the white flag with seahorses: two silver seahorses guard a blue-and-red shield, with MAYOTTE spelled out in red above them.
trivia: The motto "Ra Hachiri" means "We are vigilant" in Shimaore; the coat of arms was adopted in 1982.
Mayotte chose to stay French when the rest of the Comoros became independent in 1975; Comoros still claims it.
